title: Persist revocation tombstones for every subject
goal: Prevent a sibling memory binding from reappearing after shared revocation.
evidence: Two cross-instance regressions failed original implementation; 26 MacPolicy tests pass with fix in isolated SUSI_HOME and TEMP.
Independent review /root/revoke_bug/review approved; no blocking findings.
limitations: Hardens private preloaded attach transition. Current public constructors seed only susi defaults before attach and persisted grants are not cached; no demonstrated current public non-susi exploit.
Absent or repeated persistent revokes now write tombstones and may report write errors; return bool still describes prior local presence.
Native gate/ship remains required; no live user state touched.
